content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DHAS Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Dr Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan is scheduled for 09 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts at DHAS Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident positions at Dr Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan (DHAS Delhi).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a post-graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institution and valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Senior Resident positions at DHAS Delhi?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the DHAS Delhi Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Senior Resident posts at DHAS Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Senior Resident posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Dr Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan (DHAS Delhi) office. The exact address and reporting time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).
